Your [tactical doctrine](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.tactician.level-1/tactical-doctrine) grants you a [triggered action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action), as shown on the Doctrine [Triggered Actions](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) table.

###### Doctrine Triggered Actions Table

| Doctrine   | [Triggered Action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action) |
|------------|------------------|
| Insurgent  | [Advanced Tactics](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-1/advanced-tactics) |
| Mastermind | [Overwatch](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-1/overwatch)        |
| Vanguard   | [Parry](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.tactician.level-1/parry)            |
